title: Service boundaries for the shopping assistant: three ADRs
scenario: Kestrel's architecture review board approves the shopping assistant on Thursday. Three decisions are open: separate service or storefront module, how answers stream through the CDN and API gateway, and where model fallback and rate limiting live. Write the ADRs and defend them against the incident history.
task: ADR-1: separate service vs storefront module; catalog via API vs database
ADR-2: SSE vs WebSocket vs polling through the existing CDN and Kong
ADR-3: fallback and rate limiting in the assistant vs a shared LLM gateway
System diagram, how-it-fails table, latency and cost budget
acceptance: Every ADR compares real options against the inputs and names bad consequences
Data ownership, fail-soft and security constraints respected
Failure table covers outages, rate limits, slow dependencies and peak
Readable by the board in 15 minutes
